# Muse Wonder vs Kimi K3.1: Eight Index Points, 2.3× the Cost, and One Model You Can Download

Latest models · 20View all models →

Benchmarks: Artificial Analysis · updated daily

Back to all posts

There is no model called Kimi K3.1. Moonshot AI's documentation, pricing page, Hugging Face organisation and blog all name a single model — Kimi K3, released 16 July 2026 — and the dotted suffix is what search boxes and community posts call that line, not a release. So anyone comparing Muse Wonder against "Kimi K3.1" is really comparing Meta's 12 October 2026 model against Kimi K3, and the comparison is worth making on its own terms: 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index against 44, about $4.52 per completed index task against $2.00, and — the part that decides more deployments than either score — 2.8 trillion parameters of downloadable weights on one side and an API-only proprietary model on the other. If a page shows you a K3.1 specification, one column of it was invented. When a model name turns out to describe no shipped release, the correction is logged with its dates and sources in the AI Incident Archive, next to the other model and vendor incidents we track.

## What the dotted name resolves to

The whole naming question is answerable in three statements. Kimi K3.1 does not exist as a separate model: there is no card, no rate-card row, no API identifier and no weight repository carrying that string on Moonshot's own surfaces. The model it points at is Kimi K3, a mixture-of-experts system with 2.8 trillion total parameters and 104 billion active, a 1,048,576-token context, native image input and open weights. And the distinction matters to this comparison because the only reason to consider Kimi over Muse Wonder is that you can hold it — a property that belongs to K3 and to no hypothetical successor.

If Moonshot eventually ships a K3.1, the way to know will be a new repository in its Hugging Face organisation or a fifth row on its pricing page. Neither exists today, and nothing in this article should be read as anticipating one.

## Two ways to run a frontier model

The specification contrast is short because the two models are closer in shape than in ownership:

• Independent score — Muse Wonder 52, 9th of 213; Kimi K3 44, 5th of 121 in its cohort

• List price — Muse Wonder $4.00 in / $20.00 out / $0.20 cached per million; Kimi K3 $3.00 / $15.00 / about $0.30

• Cost per index task — Muse Wonder about $4.52; Kimi K3 about $2.00

• Output tokens on the index run — Muse Wonder about 130 million; Kimi K3 about 160 million, somewhat verbose against a 140 million median

• Context — Muse Wonder 1,048,576 tokens; Kimi K3 1,048,576 tokens

• Weights — Muse Wonder none, proprietary, API-only; Kimi K3 open weights under the Kimi K3 License, ungated on Hugging Face

• Latency — Muse Wonder 30.35 seconds to first token, 145.1 tokens per second; Kimi K3 3.90 seconds, 38.7 tokens per second

Eight index points and a 2.3× bill in Meta's favour, on the scores.

Then two rows in the other direction that no benchmark captures. Kimi K3 starts answering in under four seconds while Muse Wonder takes thirty, and Kimi K3 writes at less than a third of Muse Wonder's speed once it starts. In an interactive session that is a different product; in a batch job it is a different cost curve.
# Muse Wonder vs Kimi K3 — the scoreboard
## Muse Wonder

- Intelligence Index: 52

- List price: $4.00 / $20.00

- Cost per index task: $4.52

- First token: 30.35 s

- Output speed: 145.1 tok/s

- Weights: none, API only

## Kimi K3

- Intelligence Index: 44

- List price: $3.00 / $15.00

- Cost per index task: $2.00

- First token: 3.90 s

- Output speed: 38.7 tok/s

- Weights: open, 2.8 trillion parameters

Kimi K3.1 is a search label, not a release. Figures per Artificial Analysis and each vendor.

## The repository that is empty, next to the one that is not

This is where the two models stop being comparable. Muse Wonder has a Hugging Face repository — meta-01/muse-wonder — and it contains a single .gitattributes file. No model card, no config.json, no safetensors, no licence. The page states the model is not deployed by any inference provider on the platform. Whatever that repository is for, it is not for downloading a model, and calling Muse Wonder open-weight because a URL with its name exists is the single most common error in coverage of it.

Kimi K3, by contrast, is a real download: 2.8 trillion parameters at FP8, which is a multi-node deployment rather than a workstation experiment. Eight H100- or H200-class accelerators is the floor and in practice more, so "open weights" here means "you may self-host if you already own a cluster", not "you can run it on a laptop". The licence is the Kimi K3 License, which Moonshot describes as derived from MIT but does not call open source, and it carries conditions — including a separate commercial agreement for model-as-a-service operators above a revenue threshold, and an attribution requirement at large scale. Internal use and fine-tuning are permitted; standing up an inference business on it is not, without a contract. There is no equivalent clause to read for Muse Wonder because there are no weights to attach one to.

## What that means for a production decision

Three deployments, three different answers. If you are building a product that must not depend on a vendor's continued goodwill — regulated data, an on-premise requirement, a need to fine-tune on proprietary corpora — Kimi K3 is the only one of the two that can satisfy you at all, and the eight-point deficit is the price of that control. If you are building an agent that runs long-horizon professional tasks and can absorb a thirty-second deliberation per turn, Muse Wonder's combination of a higher score and much faster generation is the stronger raw capability, and you are renting it rather than owning it. And if you are prototyping at low volume, Kimi K3's $2.00 per task against $4.52 is a real budget difference that compounds across a month of iterations.

The trap is treating the index gap as decisive. Eight points on a 213-model board is meaningful, but it is not eight points on your task — and the two models differ by more on latency, on ownership and on licence than they do on score. A team that picks on the composite alone will pick Muse Wonder and then discover it cannot fine-tune, cannot self-host, and waits half a minute before every answer.

## Reaching both, and the one we serve

Kimi K3 is in the OrcaRouter catalogue as kimi/kimi-k3 at $3.00 input, $0.30 cached and $15.00 output per million tokens across a 1,048,576-token window — Moonshot's own list price, passed through with no markup, so any change to it is live here the same day. Muse Wonder is not in the catalogue. There is no meta/muse-wonder on OrcaRouter, and the Meta checkpoints we do serve are meta/muse-spark-1.2 and its 1.1 predecessor at $1.25 input and $4.25 output.

Where the routing layer earns its keep in this comparison is the hedge. Muse Wonder is ten days old, API-only, and independently measured once; Kimi K3 is three months old with a licence you can read. Run the hedging experiment from one key — Kimi K3 carrying the traffic you know about, a slice pointed at Muse Wonder through Meta's own API for the long-horizon cases where it is claimed to be strongest, automatic failover holding the line when a thirty-second first token becomes a timeout. If the open-weight route matters more than the score, the decision is already made and the router just makes it cheap to keep a second opinion nearby.

## The short version

Kimi K3.1 is a search term; Kimi K3 is the model, and it is the one to compare. Against Muse Wonder it gives up eight index points and about half the generation speed, and in exchange it costs less than half per completed task, answers nearly eight times sooner, and can be downloaded, fine-tuned and run inside your own infrastructure under a licence with conditions you can read before you commit. Muse Wonder is the more capable model and the less controllable one, and which of those you need is a question about your deployment, not about the leaderboard.

# xAI (Grok)

Thexai provider supports xAI's Grok models through an API interface compatible with OpenAI's format, including text, vision, image generation, video generation, and voice workflows.

## Setup

To use xAI's API, set theXAI_API_KEY environment variable or specify via apiKey in the configuration file.
export XAI_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

When xAI is the selected fallback provider family, Promptfoo can use xAI defaults for grading, suggestions, synthesis, and web search. These automatic defaults currently usegrok-4.3 on the global endpoint; select grok-4.7, grok-4.6, or grok-4.5 explicitly where they are available. xAI does not currently expose a public embeddings or moderation API, so those defaults fall back to OpenAI when xAI is selected. Explicit provider IDs in your config still take precedence.

## Supported Models

The xAI provider includes support for the following model formats. xAI recommendsgrok-4.7 for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work; consult the public model catalog for current availability.

Legacy xAI model aliases

xAI periodically retires older model slugs and keeps them working through redirects. As of the May 15, 2026 (12:00 PM PT) retirement, requests to thegrok-4-1-fast, grok-4-fast, grok-4-0709, and grok-3 families redirect to grok-4.3 and use Grok 4.3 pricing. Requests to grok-code-fast-1 route to grok-build-0.1, while grok-imagine-image-pro routes to grok-imagine-image-quality. For new configs, use a current canonical model ID directly.

Regional model availability

xAI documents Grok 4.7 on its global and US regional endpoints, and announced Grok 4.5 availability in the EU API Console. Check your account before depending on Grok 4.7 in another region;grok-4.3 remains Promptfoo's automatic fallback.

### Grok 4.7 Models

- xai:grok-4.7 - Chat Completions; 500K context, text and image input, text output
- xai:responses:grok-4.7 - Responses API, including server-side tools and encrypted reasoning

Use the exactgrok-4.7 model ID. Grok 4.7 Fast is available in Cursor and Grok Build, but not on the public xAI API.

### Grok 4.6 Models

- xai:grok-4.6 - Previous flagship reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work (500K context, text and image input)

xAI does not publish any aliases for this model, so target the exactgrok-4.6 id. There is no grok-4.6-latest.

### Grok 4.5 Models

- xai:grok-4.5 - Flagship reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work (500K context, text and image input)
- xai:grok-4.5-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.5 family
- xai:grok-build-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.5 family

### Grok 4.3 Models

- xai:grok-4.3 - General-purpose reasoning model
- xai:grok-4.3-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.3 family
- xai:grok-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.3 family

### Grok 4.20 Models

- xai:grok-4.20-0309-reasoning - Reasoning model
- xai:grok-4.20 - Alias for the Grok 4.20 reasoning family
- xai:grok-4.20-reasoning - Alias for the Grok 4.20 reasoning family
- xai:grok-4.20-reasoning-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.20 reasoning family
- xai:grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning - Non-reasoning variant
- xai:grok-4.20-non-reasoning - Alias for the Grok 4.20 non-reasoning family
- xai:grok-4.20-non-reasoning-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.20 non-reasoning family
- xai:grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309 - Multi-agent variant
- xai:grok-4.20-multi-agent - Alias for the Grok 4.20 multi-agent family
- xai:grok-4.20-multi-agent-latest - Alias for the Grok 4.20 multi-agent family

### Grok 4.1 Fast Models

These legacy IDs remain recognized for backward compatibility and redirect to Grok 4.3:

- xai:grok-4-1-fast-reasoning and its -latest aliases - Redirect with low reasoning effort
- xai:grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning and its -latest aliases - Redirect with reasoning disabled

### Grok Code Fast Models

- xai:grok-build-0.1 - Canonical Grok Build coding model (256K context)
- xai:grok-code-fast-1 - Legacy alias that routes to grok-build-0.1
- xai:grok-code-fast - Alias for grok-build-0.1
- xai:grok-code-fast-1-0825 - Versioned alias for grok-build-0.1

### Grok-4 Fast Models

These legacy IDs remain recognized for backward compatibility and redirect to Grok 4.3:

- xai:grok-4-fast-reasoning and its aliases - Redirect with low reasoning effort
- xai:grok-4-fast-non-reasoning and its aliases - Redirect with reasoning disabled

### Grok-4 Models

- xai:grok-4-0709, xai:grok-4, and xai:grok-4-latest - Legacy IDs that redirect to Grok 4.3 with low reasoning effort

### Grok-3 Models

Thegrok-3, grok-3-beta, grok-3-fast, and related -latest IDs are legacy aliases that redirect to Grok 4.3. Promptfoo also recognizes the older Grok 3 Mini IDs for backward compatibility; verify their availability for your xAI account before relying on them.

### Grok-2 and previous Models

Promptfoo recognizes oldergrok-2, grok-beta, and vision IDs for existing configs, but they are not in xAI's current public catalog. Use a current model for new configs and verify legacy availability in the xAI Console.

## Configuration

The provider uses OpenAI-compatible configuration options plus Grok-specific options, subject to the model restrictions below. Example usage:

When xAI returnsusage.cost_in_usd_ticks, Promptfoo uses that exact billed amount, including cache discounts and request-level pricing adjustments. If ticks are unavailable, Promptfoo falls back to the model's catalog rates and applies the documented 2x premium when the response confirms service_tier: priority. Custom pricing can be set with cost, inputCost, outputCost, and cacheReadCost (all per-token rates); explicit overrides take precedence over reported ticks and are used as final rates without an additional priority multiplier.
providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.7
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      reasoning_effort: 'xhigh' # low, medium, high (default), or xhigh
      apiKey: your_api_key_here # Alternative to XAI_API_KEY

Bothxai:<model> Chat Completions and xai:responses:<model> support xAI
Priority Processing.
Set service_tier to priority for higher scheduling priority or default for standard
processing; omitting it also uses the default tier. Other OpenAI-compatible tier names are not
valid on xAI.

### Reasoning Support

Multiple Grok models support reasoning capabilities:

Grok 4.7 and 4.6: Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to low, medium, high (the default), or xhigh. Responses API requests use reasoning.effort. Reasoning cannot be disabled; Promptfoo rejects none locally.

For Grok 4.7, cap output withmax_completion_tokens for Chat Completions or max_output_tokens for Responses. Chat also accepts max_tokens as an alias; use one spelling throughout an eval, including defaults and test cases. Within test options, set a request option directly or under passthrough, not both. Reasoning effort accepts a direct eval variable such as {{ effort }}; see the optional Grok 4.7 providers in the xAI chat example.

Grok 4.5: Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to low, medium, or high (the default); Promptfoo rejects other values locally. Responses API requests use reasoning.effort with the same values.

Grok 4.3: General-purpose reasoning model. Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to none, low, medium, or high; Responses API requests use reasoning.effort.

Grok Code Fast Models: Thegrok-code-fast-1 family are reasoning models optimized for agentic coding workflows. They support:

- Function calling and tool usage
- Web search viasearch_parameters
- Fast inference with built-in reasoning

### Grok 4.7 Specific Behavior

The xAI release notes list $2/M input, $0.50/M cached input, and $6/M output. At 200K or more input tokens, the rates are $4/M, $1/M, and $12/M respectively. When the API does not return a billed cost, Promptfoo uses these rates, including the 10% premium on xAI's US endpoint; explicit custom rates still take precedence. As with other Grok 4 reasoning models, Promptfoo stripspresence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop.

The Responses API returns encrypted reasoning even wheninclude is omitted. Promptfoo keeps it in response.raw.output; pass these items back unchanged when managing conversation history yourself.

### Grok 4.5 Specific Behavior

Grok 4.5 is an earlier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work:

- 500K context window with text and image input
- Configurable reasoning:reasoning_effort accepts low, medium, or high (defaults to high); none is rejected
- Long-context pricing: requests with at least 200K input tokens use the higher catalog rate ($4/M input, $0.60/M cached input, and $12/M output instead of $2/M, $0.30/M, and $6/M); Promptfoo uses the exact billed ticks when xAI returns them
- Unsupported parameters:presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop are rejected, and Promptfoo strips them automatically
- Ignored parameters: xAI silently ignoreslogprobs and top_logprobs on Grok 4.20 and newer models
- Server-side tools: usexai:responses:grok-4.5 for web search, X search, code execution, and MCP

providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.5
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      reasoning_effort: medium
      max_completion_tokens: 4096

### Grok 4.3 Specific Behavior

Grok 4.3 is a general-purpose alternative for text workflows:

- Responses API recommended: Usexai:responses:grok-4.3 for server-side tools, multi-turn state, and newer xAI capabilities
- Configurable reasoning: Setreasoning_effort to none, low, medium, or high
- Unsupported parameters: Same restrictions as other Grok 4-family reasoning models (presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop)

providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.3
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      max_completion_tokens: 4096

Grok-3 Models: Promptfoo retains the legacy Grok 3 Mini reasoning-effort contract for backward compatibility. Use Grok 4.3 or Grok 4.7 for new configurations.

试试全新的 OrcaCyber Zero 1.5——连接任意网络靶场，用于攻防安全、零日漏洞与 AI 防御 🐳获取 API

Guides & Insights

# Claude Duet 与 Grok Bot：谁会未经询问就行动？

最新模型 · 20查看全部模型 →

基准测试：Artificial Analysis · 每日更新

返回全部文章

关于任何智能体，真正有意思的问题不在于它能做什么，而在于在你点头同意之前它会做什么。Claude Duet是 Anthropic 对这个问题给出的答案，于 2026 年 10 月 21 日发布，并围绕 Claude Opus 5.5设计。Grok Bot是 SpaceXAI 向订阅用户销售的付费智能体产品，而它在同一个问题上的公开记录却呈现出截然不同的面貌。两者都能登录你的邮箱、你的 CRM 和你的网页应用，并把一项工作执行到底。在公开层面区分它们的并非能力，而是这两家公司当中，究竟哪一家把智能体即将做出某个不可撤销之举的那一刻会发生什么，白纸黑字地写了下来。

先作一项披露，因为它会影响后面的一切。SpaceXAI 自己的文档我们没能加载：在撰写本文时，该网站对每次抓取尝试都返回 HTTP 403。因此，不像 Duet 那样有第一方的 Grok Bot 页面可供引用。下面 Grok Bot 一栏中的所有内容，都来自本博客自身报道中的早前文章；这些文章引用了其来源，并描述了截至 2026 年 10 月 21 日的产品情况。请把那一栏理解为对公开记录的解读，而不是厂商的规格说明，并在购买任何东西之前重新查看他们的页面。

关于名称，只说明一次。grok bot、grokbot和claude bot，人们这样输入时，仿佛这三者都是产品名称。但只有 Grok Bot 是产品名；“Claude bot”只是对基于 Claude 构建的智能体的描述，并非 Anthropic 所售之物。Grok Bot 背后的公司在我们此前的报道中写作 SpaceXAI，在公开记录的其他地方则写作 xAI，而在这里，两个名称指的是同一家公司。

## 两份记录，发布方式截然不同

Anthropic 于 2026 年 10 月 21 日发布了一页说明，直接回答了那些棘手的问题。它说明了即使获得你的许可，Duet 也不会做什么。它说明了由谁、在何时批准某项操作。它说明了凭证如何保管，以及发布前测试了什么。它还主动列出了限制清单、一项地区限制和一项等候名单条件——这些通常是营销页面会略去的部分。你可以不同意这些回答，但不能说它们被隐瞒了。

Grok Bot 的记录呈现出相反的形态：是一系列带日期的能力公告，而非一份规格说明。根据我们此前的报道，2026 年 8 月 11 日的早期测试版为每个 Bot 配备了一台专用云计算机，可登录 Gmail、一个 CRM 和各类 Web 应用，并端到端完成任务，仅在需要做出决策或获得批准时才现身。8 月 21 日档位扩大，8 月 26 日再次扩大；9 月 2 日推出 Android 版；9 月 28 日推出共享 Team Bots；10 月 1 日由产品自己的账号介绍了一款能发现工作并主动提出处理的 Primary Bot；10 月 7 日推出原生搜索和监控 X；从 10 月 9 日起可申领 @mail.grokbot.com 地址；10 月 21 日推出报告、备忘录和仪表盘。每一项都是一项能力。其中没有一项是审批规则。

## 它可能未经询问就执行的操作

Duet 会自行阅读、起草并准备工作。在它发送消息、进行付款、签署文件或删除任何内容之前，它会准确展示自己即将做什么，并等待你的批准。注意这条界线划在哪里：它划在动作类别周围，而不是划在任务如何开始周围。定时任务和你亲手输入的请求会经过同一道关卡。这是两种设计中更清晰的一种，也是以你可以事先核查的形式公布的那一种。

根据我们早前的报道，Grok Bot 公开的表述关乎返回环节，而非具体操作。该 Bot 在自己的云端计算机中运行，当需要做出决定或获得批准时，它会回到你这里。这句话确实有实际作用——它告诉你存在一个检查点——但它没有说明哪些决定符合条件，或需要哪些批准。我们的报道所汇总的记录中，没有列出任何无人监督的操作，也没有说明定时例程与一次性请求是否受到同等对待。

公允的总结是，Duet 的规则更窄且有文档记录，而 Grok Bot 的规则更宽且没有文档记录。这并不是在声称某一款产品更安全，而是在说明买家能核实什么；如今两者之中只有一个可以从外部核实。

## 即使你提出要求，它也会拒绝什么

Anthropic 划定了一条底线。即使你批准，也有几件事属于禁区，包括证券交易和账户间转账——这些不是你可以点击确认的提示，而是根本不在范围内。除此之外，还有一个专门的分类器和安全系统提示词，会检查每条消息是否泄露敏感信息，拒绝分享信用卡号和政府身份证件的请求，并且只有在智能体被明确指示发送健康或个人财务详细信息时，才予以放行。红队和一家外部公司对产品进行了渗透测试，并且它还被纳入公开的漏洞赏金计划。

Grok Bot 的过往记录并未提供同等的底线保障。最鲜明的例证是 10 月 9 日的电子邮箱地址一事：根据我们此前的报道，Bot 可以申领一个以 @mail.grokbot.com 结尾的地址，并用它注册服务、代表你联系企业，或与某人预约时间。无论意图如何，这项能力都贴近 Anthropic 明确划出的账户创建与身份领域。我们此前的报道发现，Grok Bot 在被直接询问时会拒绝什么，没有任何公开说明；对于在智能体与外部世界之间设置内容分类器，也没有任何描述。这种缺失并不能证明存在不良行为。它是证据的缺失，而对于购买决策来说，这本身就是一种答案。

## 它是否曾看到你的密码

Duet 的凭据处理遵循 Anthropic 为 Claude Managed Agents 采用的设计，因此智能体永远不会直接看到你的密码或登录令牌。这是一个结构性的答案，而不是政策上的承诺：模型从一开始就不会拿到密钥，这意味着注入到网页中的诱导性指令没有任何可提取的内容。上文所述的外发分类器则是第二层防护，针对的是模型试图输出的内容。

正如我们早前报道所述，Grok Bot 的架构使凭证问题具有关键支撑作用，这一点值得直白说明。一台专门登录 Gmail 和 CRM 的云端计算机，在功能上就是以你的身份登录。正是这种设计使端到端完成任务成为可能，也正是这种设计将每一个下游会话置于智能体所控制的机器之内。我们的报道并未查明这些凭证如何存储、模型能否读取它们，或者是否有第二个分类器检查外发内容。这些是应当向供应商提出的问题，而一份比较能诚实说出的一点是：这些问题尚未在公开场合得到回答。

## 断开连接实际上会删除什么

Anthropic 表示，你可以断开 Claude Duet 有权访问的任何应用。但它没有说明 Duet 已从该应用学到的东西会如何处理，也没有描述任何涵盖记忆和计划任务的重置操作。这是文档中的一处缺口，而非更糟行为的证据，但它确实是个缺口，诚实的解读是：Duet 的保留语义尚未公开。对于任何涉及客户记录的事项，这个问题应在你连接账户之前提出，而不是之后。

Grok Bot 的留存问题更难回答，因为产品会积累更多关于你的信息。根据我们早前的报道，Bot 会建立已完成任务的历史记录，自9月28日起可能通过 Team Bots 与同事共享状态，并且可能持有一个电子邮件地址，而该地址本身就是它代表你创建的账户的恢复途径。在这样的系统中，移除一个连接器显然不等同于移除 Bot 所知道的内容。我们的报道发现根本没有公开的删除语义。如果你正在考虑将其中一种用于共享收件箱或面向客户的工作流，那么这是最有可能在一年后变得重要、也最不可能在发布页面上得到回答的单个问题。

## 背景调查在套餐限制中的费用是多少

Duet 已在研究预览期间包含在 Pro 和 Max 中，并与 Claude 的其他部分共享你所在套餐的使用额度。但它的消耗方式不同：后台检查会计入这些额度，而构建财务模型等更大的任务则需要更多模型轮次和更多后台工作。Anthropic 将每隔几小时运行一次的节奏解释为一种成本控制——如果不停检查，套餐额度会消耗得快得多——这是一句伪装成脚注的、颇为有用的坦白。

Grok Bot 以订阅访问权而非按量计费的智能体时间来销售。根据我们早前的报道，现存的计量项是每周包含用量，而且它计量的是账户，而非 Bot。这是一种站得住脚的商业设计，但对预算编制并无帮助：当被计数的对象不是检查本身时，你就无法为重复性的背景调查定价。十月的整合将 Bot 并入与供应商其余产品相同的单一订阅，这让打包方式更简单，却并未让单位经济效益变得更清晰。

## 五个问题，一张卡片

把这两份记录并排放在一起，不对称性就很容易把握了。只有一个厂商公布了这些问题的答案，而这些问题决定了某个智能体是否该进入你的账户。下面的卡片将这篇文章浓缩为五个值得提出的问题，它值得你在试用时随身带着，而不是只读一遍。

## 引擎问题，以及那句越界的话

有一点是两份记录相互吻合之处，而这不是一个安全问题。根据我们此前的报道，2026年10月7日，埃隆·马斯克在X上表示，公司将针对任何给定任务使用最佳后端模型，并点名了Claude Opus 5.5、MidJourney、Suno及其他领先API，理由是Bot应当调用最有可能产生最佳结果的模型。这一表态在两天内被The Information、Gizmodo、9to5Mac、Android Headlines、TechRepublic和音乐行业媒体报道。它仍然只是一项表态：记录中不存在价目表、变更日志条目、已交付的产物，也不存在对其的外部测量。

无论如何都要认真对待，因为它暗示了这两个产品的一些情况。Duet 是围绕 Claude Opus 5.5 设计的，无法指向其他厂商的模型。而 Grok Bot，如果其十月宣称的功能最终成为已交付的行为，那么它明确的设计目标是：将每项任务路由给最适合胜出的模型——而根据我们现有的公开记录，Claude Opus 5.5 被列为目的地之一。一个是应用内固定的引擎。另一个则可能把引擎当作商品来对待。

对任何选择自建而非购买的人来说，这一区别具有实际优势。Claude Opus 5.5 已在 OrcaRouter 上提供，价格为每百万输入 token 4.00 美元、每百万输出 token 20.00 美元，具有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，缓存读取为每百万 0.20 美元；通过一个兼容 OpenAI 的密钥即可访问 200 多个模型，不高于提供商标价，并支持跨提供商自动故障转移。准确说明它不是什么：OrcaRouter 不托管 Claude Duet 或 Grok Bot，这两款产品也都不能通过我们的 API 运行。你能做的是，将同一个模型置于你自己编写的循环之中，让它在消费级方案本会中断时仍持续运行。

## 连接账户前该问什么

这两款产品并非等价的购买选择，差异也不在于它们背后的模型。Duet 的记录是一份规格说明：提出并回答了五个问题，其中缺口——留存率和每完成一项任务的价格——被明确点名为缺口，而不是用自信的辞藻来填补。Grok Bot 的记录是一条能力时间线：它能触及什么、这种触及何时扩展，以及谁能购买它。时间线告诉你一个产品在前进，却不会告诉你它在哪里停下。

这种不对称应当影响你如何评估它们，而不是影响你选择哪一个。使用 Duet，你可以阅读那些拒绝记录，找到你不认同的一条，并在投入一周时间之前决定自己能否接受它。对于 Grok Bot，你是凭一场演示和一系列公告来购买，而审批语义、凭据处理和删除规则仍是悬而未决的问题，试用未必能给出答案，因为试用展示的是智能体做了什么，而不是它被允许做什么。

那就去问。找到那句说明智能体在无需询问的情况下可以做什么的话，并检查它是否既涵盖研究，也涵盖计划任务。找到拒绝清单，看看它是产品不会做的事情清单，还是你可以覆盖的事情清单。弄清是模型本身会持有你的凭据，还是由单独的一层持有。找到删除规则，并注意断开连接是否会移除已经学到的东西。弄清后台检查是否会消耗你的套餐，以及消耗速率如何。一家供应商在发布当天以书面形式回答了全部五个问题。另一家还没有，而这是本次比较中最有用的事实。

# Claude Duet 對決 Grok Bot：誰會不問就行動？

關於任何代理式 AI，真正有趣的問題不是它能做什麼，而是它在你說「好」之前會做什麼。Claude Duet是 Anthropic 對這個問題的回答，於 2026 年 10 月 21 日發表，並以Claude Opus 5.5為核心設計。Grok Bot是 SpaceXAI 賣給訂閱者的付費代理產品，而它在同一個問題上的公開紀錄讀起來截然不同。兩者都能登入你的電子郵件、CRM 和網頁應用程式，並把一項工作執行到底。在公開層面上區隔兩者的不是能力，而是這兩家公司裡，哪一家把代理即將執行不可逆操作時會發生什麼事寫了下來。

先作一項披露，因為它會影響後續所有內容。SpaceXAI 自己的文件在我們這邊無法載入：撰寫本文期間，該網站對每一次抓取嘗試都回傳 HTTP 403。因此，沒有像 Duet 那樣有第一方 Grok Bot 頁面可供引用。下方 Grok Bot 專欄中的所有內容，均來自本部落格自身報導中的較早報導；該報導引用了其消息來源，並描述截至 2026 年 10 月 21 日的產品狀況。請將該專欄視為對公開紀錄的解讀，而非廠商的規格說明，並在購買任何東西前重新查看其頁面。

關於名稱，說明一次。人們會輸入 grok bot、grokbot 和 claude bot，彷彿這三者都是產品名稱。只有 Grok Bot 是產品名稱；「Claude bot」是對一個以 Claude 建構的代理程式的描述，並非 Anthropic 販售的東西。Grok Bot 背後的公司，在我們先前的報導中稱為 SpaceXAI，在公開紀錄的其他地方則稱為 xAI，而在這裡這兩個名稱指的是同一家公司。

## 兩張唱片，發行方式卻大不相同

Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 21 日發布了一頁文件，直接回答了那些棘手的問題。它說明了 Duet 即使獲得你的許可也不會做什麼。它說明了誰會在何時批准某項操作。它說明了憑證如何保管，以及上線前測試了什麼。它還主動列出限制清單、區域限制和候補名單條件——這些都是行銷頁面通常會省略的部分。你可以不同意這些答案，但不能說它們被隱瞞了。

Grok Bot 的紀錄呈現相反的樣貌：是一連串附有日期的功能公告，而非一份規格書。根據我們先前的報導，2026 年 8 月 11 日的早期測試版讓每個 Bot 都有一台專屬雲端電腦，可登入 Gmail、CRM 與網頁應用程式，並端到端完成工作，只有在需要做決定或核准時才現身。方案層級於 8 月 21 日擴大，並於 8 月 26 日再次擴大；Android 版本於 9 月 2 日登場；共享 Team Bots 於 9 月 28 日推出；能發現工作並主動提出處理的 Primary Bot，由產品自家帳號於 10 月 1 日描述；10 月 7 日推出原生搜尋與監控 X；10 月 9 日起可申請 @mail.grokbot.com 地址；10 月 21 日推出報告、備忘錄與儀表板。每一項都是功能。沒有一項是核准規則。

## 它可能未經詢問就做的事

Duet 會自行閱讀、起草並準備工作。在它送出訊息、進行付款、簽署文件或刪除任何內容之前，它會確切顯示即將執行的動作，並等待你的核准。請注意這條界線落在哪裡：它是劃在動作類別周圍，而不是劃在任務如何開始周圍。排程工作和你口頭輸入的請求，都會碰到同一道關卡。這是兩者中較為簡潔的設計，也是以可事先查核的形式公布的那一種。

Grok Bot 對外公布的说法，根据我们先前的报导，讲的是回程而非行动。Bot 在自己的云端电脑中运作，并在需要做出决定或核准时回到你身边。那句话确实有其作用——它告诉你存在一个检查点——但它并未说明哪些决定符合条件，或哪些核准是必要的。我们的报导所汇整的记录中，没有任何未受监督行动的清单，也没有任何陈述说明排程例行事项与一次性请求是否受到相同对待。

公平的總結是，Duet 的規則範圍較窄且有明文記載，而 Grok Bot 的規則範圍較廣且未明文記載。這並不是在宣稱哪一款產品更安全。這是關於買方能驗證什麼的主張，而如今兩者中只有一個能從外部驗證。

## 即使你開口要求，它仍會拒絕什麼

Anthropic 設定了一道底線。有些事即使你批准也不能做，包括買賣證券和在帳戶之間轉移資金——這不是可按一下就能通過的提示，而是超出範圍。除此之外，還有一套專用的分類器和安全系統提示，會檢查每則訊息是否有敏感資訊外洩，拒絕分享信用卡號碼和政府身分證件的請求，並且只有在代理程式已被明確指示要傳送時，才放行健康或個人財務細節。紅隊和一家外部公司對產品進行了滲透測試，且產品涵蓋在公開的漏洞賞金計畫中。

Grok Bot 的紀錄並未提供同等的最低保障。最鮮明的例證是 10 月 9 日的電子郵件地址：根據我們先前的報導，Bot 可以取得一個以 @mail.grokbot.com 結尾的地址，並用它註冊服務、代表你聯絡企業，或與某人安排時間。無論用意為何，這項能力都接近 Anthropic 明確劃清界線的帳號建立與身分領域。我們先前的報導發現，沒有公開聲明說明 Grok Bot 在被直接詢問時會拒絕什麼，也沒有描述有內容分類器介於代理與外部世界之間。這種缺失並非不當行為的證據。這是證據的缺失，而對購買決策而言，這本身就是一種答案。

## 它是否曾看到您的密碼

Duet 的憑證處理方式遵循 Anthropic 為 Claude Managed Agents 所採用的設計，因此代理程式永遠不會直接看到你的密碼或登入權杖。這是結構性的答案，而非政策上的承諾：模型從一開始就不會拿到機密，這意味著網頁中遭注入的具說服力指令根本無從擷取任何東西。前述的輸出分類器則是第二層防護，針對的是模型試圖輸出的內容。

Grok Bot 的架構，正如我們先前的報導所述，使憑證問題成為關鍵所在，值得直言說明。一台專用雲端電腦若登入 Gmail 和 CRM，功能上就等同於以你的身分登入。這正是讓端到端完成得以可能的設計，也正是把每個下游工作階段置於代理程式所控制機器內的設計。我們的報導並未確認這些憑證如何儲存、模型是否能讀取它們，或是否有第二個分類器檢查對外送出的內容。這些是該向供應商提出的問題，而比較報導能誠實說的一件事，就是這些問題尚未在公開場合獲得回答。

## 中斷連線實際上會刪除什麼

Anthropic 表示你可以中斷 Claude Duet 有權存取的任何應用程式。它並未說明 Duet 已從該應用程式學到的內容會如何處理，也沒有描述涵蓋記憶與排程任務的重設操作。這是文件上的缺口，而非更糟行為的證據，但這確實是個缺口，而誠實的解讀是 Duet 的保留語意並未公開。對於任何涉及客戶紀錄的事務，這個問題應該在連結帳戶之前提出，而不是之後。

Grok Bot 的留存問題更難回答，因為這個產品會累積更多關於你的資料。根據我們先前的報導，Bot 會建立已完成工作的歷史記錄，自 9 月 28 日起可能透過 Team Bots 與同事共享狀態，並且可能持有一個電子郵件地址，而該地址本身正是它代表你建立之帳號的復原途徑。在這樣的系統中，移除連接器顯然不等同於移除 Bot 所知道的內容。我們的報導發現，完全沒有公開的刪除語意。如果你正考慮將其中一項用於共用收件匣或面向客戶的工作流程，這是最可能在一年後變得重要、卻最不可能在發布頁面上獲得解答的單一問題。

## 背景調查在方案限制中的費用是多少

Duet 在研究預覽期間包含於 Pro 和 Max 方案中，並與 Claude 其餘部分共用你方案的用量上限。它消耗這些上限的方式不同：背景檢查會計入這些上限，而建立財務模型等較大型任務需要更多模型回合與更多背景作業。Anthropic 將每隔數小時的節奏解釋為成本控制——不間斷檢查會更快耗盡方案上限——這是一項偽裝成註腳的有用承認。

Grok Bot 是以訂閱存取的方式販售，而不是按代理執行時間計量。根據我們先前的報導，確實存在的計量機制是每週內含用量，而且它計量的是帳戶，而不是 Bot。這在商業設計上站得住腳，但對預算編列卻毫無幫助：當被計量的東西不是那項檢查時，你就無法為重複進行的背景檢查定價。十月的那次整併把 Bot 與該供應商的其他產品一起收進單一訂閱方案，讓包裝變得更簡單，卻沒有讓單位經濟效益變得更清楚易懂。

## 五個問題，一張卡

把這兩份紀錄並排攤開，這種不對稱就很容易掌握。只有一家廠商公開回答了那些決定代理程式能否進入你帳戶內部的問題。下方這張卡片，是把文章濃縮成五個真正值得提出的問題；它值得帶進試用過程反覆對照，而不是只讀一遍。

## 引擎問題，以及那句越線的陳述

有一個點是這兩份紀錄交會之處，而這不是安全問題。根據我們先前的報導，2026 年 10 月 7 日，Elon Musk 在 X 上表示，公司會針對任何特定任務採用最佳的後端模型，並點名 Claude Opus 5.5、MidJourney、Suno 和其他領先的 API，理由是 Bot 應選用最可能產生最佳結果的方案。該聲明在兩天內被 The Information、Gizmodo、9to5Mac、Android Headlines、TechRepublic 和音樂產業媒體引用。它仍然只是一項聲明：紀錄中沒有費率表、沒有變更記錄條目、沒有已交付的成品，也沒有對它的外部量測。

儘管如此，仍要認真看待，因為這對這兩款產品所代表的意義非同小可。Duet 是圍繞 Claude Opus 5.5 設計的，無法指向其他廠商的模型。Grok Bot 則不然：如果十月的那項說法成為實際出貨行為，它明確的設計就是將每項任務路由給最能勝任的模型——而在我們掌握的公開紀錄中，Claude Opus 5.5 被列為目的地之一。一個是應用程式內的固定引擎。另一個則可能把引擎當成可替換的商品。

這種區別對自行打造而非直接購買的人來說有實際優勢。Claude Opus 5.5 可在 OrcaRouter 上使用，每百萬輸入 token 為 $4.00、每百萬輸出 token 為 $20.00，具備 100 萬 token 的上下文視窗，快取讀取為每百萬 $0.20，並可透過一組相容 OpenAI 的金鑰存取超過 200 個模型，且不加收供應商定價之上的費用，並可在供應商之間自動容錯移轉。確切說明這不是什麼：OrcaRouter 不託管 Claude Duet 或 Grok Bot，這兩項產品都無法透過我們的 API 執行。你能做的是把你撰寫的迴圈套用到同一個模型上，並在消費者方案原本會讓它停止時，讓它繼續運行。

## 在連結帳戶前該問什麼

這兩項產品並非等價的採購，而差異也不在於它們背後的模型。Duet 的紀錄是一份規格：提出並回答了五個問題，其中缺口——留存率與每完成一項任務的價格——被明確標示為缺口，而非以自信的文句填補。Grok Bot 的紀錄則是一條能力時間軸：它能觸及什麼、這份觸及範圍何時擴張，以及誰能買到它。時間軸告訴你產品正在前進，卻不會告訴你它會在哪裡停下來。

這種不對稱應該影響你如何評估它們，而不是影響你選擇哪一個。使用 Duet，你可以閱讀那些拒絕案例，找出你不認同的一項，並在花上一週之前決定自己能否接受。使用 Grok Bot，你是在憑藉一次示範和一組公告的力道購買，而核准語意、憑證處理和刪除規則仍是未解的問題，試用未必能回答，因為試用展示的是代理做了什麼，而不是它被允許做什麼。

那就問吧。找出那句說明代理可以未經詢問就做什麼的話，並檢查它是否同時涵蓋排程工作和研究。找出拒絕事項清單，看看它列出的是產品不會做的事，還是你可以覆寫的事。查明模型是否曾持有你的憑證，還是由另一個獨立層持有。找出刪除規則，並注意中斷連線是否會移除已經學到的內容。查明背景檢查是否會消耗你的方案額度，以及以什麼費率消耗。有一家廠商在推出當天以書面回答了全部五項。另一家尚未如此，而這是這項比較中最有用的一項事實。

Short-term rental hosts spend their evenings answering the same guest questions and wondering why their listing keeps getting passed over. You can fix both. With AI, you can deliver a rewritten Airbnb listing, a house manual, and a ready-to-send guest message kit in about three hours per property, and charge 200-600 per property.

Hosts are drowning in repetitive work. Check-in questions, Wi-Fi codes, and review replies eat hours every week, and a host with a few properties rarely wants a full-time manager. A one-time kit is an easy yes.

xAI.content:
# xAI 发布了语音模型 Grok Voice 3.0，星链每天 2 万通电话，7 成 AI 接通

上一次你给客服打电话，对面是真人还是机器？

你可能会说："废话，我一听就知道。"

但如果我告诉你，Starlink（星链）的客服中心每天要接约 2 万通电话，其中大约 70% 全程没有真人参与，而且每 4 通销售电话，就有 1 通在对方挂电话之前成交，你还敢这么肯定吗？

这不是科幻小说。10 月份，xAI 发布了语音模型 Grok Voice 3.0，上面这些数字是官方公布的使用情况。

# 它到底是个什么东西？

一句话：一个能像真人一样"听和说"的 AI。

你可能用过语音助手，它们的毛病大家都懂：

- 你说完话，它愣两三秒才回应；
- 你想插一句嘴，它就"死机"了；
- 周围稍微吵一点，它就听不懂。

这些毛病有一个技术上的根源。传统做法是三步走：先把你的声音转成文字，再让 AI 读文字、想答案，最后把答案转回语音。三步串联，延迟自然高。

Grok Voice 3.0 是"语音直接到语音"（speech-to-speech）的模型，省掉了中间的转写。官方称响应延迟低于 1 秒，在对话中被打断、有停顿、轮流说话的表现也更自然。

# 它厉不厉害？官方晒了这些成绩

在第三方测评机构 Artificial Analysis 的语音综合榜单上，Grok Voice 3.0 得分 86.9，排第一，上一代是 81.3，OpenAI 的 GPT-Live-1 是 83.2，谷歌的 Gemini 3.8 Live 是 82.6。

其中一项叫"全双工测试"，衡量 AI 处理停顿、插话、抢话的自然程度，它拿到了 97%。

| | Grok Voice 3.0 | Grok Voice 2.0 | GPT-Live-1 (Astra, Medium) | Gemini 3.8 Live (Ext. Thinking, High) |

| Overall | 86.9 | 81.3 | 83.2 | 82.6 |

| AA Speech-to-Speech Index | | | | |

| Speech Reasoning | 98.5% | 97.2% | 90.1% | 97.7% |

| Big Bench Audio | | | | |

| Human Preference | 1070 | 1011 | 1048 | 990 |

| Speech Agent Arena Elo | | | | |

| Task Completion | 94.8% | 94.6% | 87.4% | 89.1% |

| Task Success Rate | | | | |

| Conversational Dynamics | 97.0% | 95.1% | 94.9% | 91.9% |

| Full Duplex Bench | | | | |

头杀@人工智能研究所

价格方面，官方说在同样的测试任务里，跑一次的成本是 0.025 美元，比 GPT-Live-1 的 0.030 美元和 GPT-Realtime-2.1 的 0.055 美元都低。

我要泼一点冷水。 这些成绩是 xAI 自己在发布页上引用的，榜单虽然由第三方机构做，但选哪些指标来展示是厂家决定的。而且并不是每项都赢：在"模拟客服通话"的 τ-Voice 测试里，Grok 得 71.6%，GPT-Live-1 是 74.5%，其实略高一点。xAI 的说法是两者相当，但 Grok 的延迟低 40%。所以更准确的结论是：它不一定在每个单项上最强，但"又快又准又便宜"的平衡做得很好。

# 真正让人后背发凉的，是已经在用了

榜单只是纸面成绩，部署规模才是硬指标：

- 特斯拉汽车里，每天有数百万次对话由它处理。司机可以不动手，让它查日程、回邮件，甚至点咖啡、订餐厅。
- Starlink 客服每天约 2 万通电话，多语言覆盖。一个 AI 就能完成验证身份、排查硬件故障、发放补偿、安排寄送替换设备这一整套流程。

想想看，这些事过去都得由一个训练有素、轮班工作的人来做。

# 它很便宜，便宜得有点吓人

每分钟 0.08 美元，一小时 4.8 美元，折合人民币三十多块（按近期汇率粗算）。它不用吃饭、不用休息、不会情绪失控，还能同时接很多通电话。

价格和上一代一样，使用 grok-voice-latest 的开发者，已经被自动升级到新版本，不用改任何东西。

# 它还能"克隆声音"

文档里有一个不起眼的功能：自定义声音（Custom Voices）。

上传一段最长 120 秒的录音，系统就会生成一个专属的声音 ID，之后这个声音就能说任何话、说多种语言。

这是一把双刃剑。好的一面是，品牌可以拥有自己的专属客服声音，视障者能用亲人的声音听书。坏的一面你也能想到：如果有人拿到你一段录音呢？这类技术的滥用风险，是整个行业都绕不开的问题，也值得你留意身边那些"听起来像熟人"的来电。

官方还说，音频数据实时处理，不存储、不用于训练，并提到 SOC 2、HIPAA 可用、GDPR 等合规认证。这些同样是厂家的说法，企业用户真要上线，仍然建议自己审核。

# 意味着什么？

- 客服电话会越来越"像人"。 你以后可能很难分辨对面是谁。如果你有疑问，直接问"你是 AI 吗？"，这个习惯值得养成。
- 简单重复的岗位会先被冲击。 查订单、改地址、报修、发补偿，这类标准流程最先被替代。
- 体验可能会变好。 如果 AI 不再让你等 20 分钟、不再把你转来转去，其实不少人是欢迎的。
- 识别骗局更重要了。 声音可以被克隆，"电话里是熟人的声音"不再等于"真的是熟人"。涉及转账，务必换个渠道二次确认。

# 它是怎么实现的？

文档里列出了三类能力：

内置有近 30 种声音（如 eve、rex、luna 等），默认是 eve，支持 38 种以上语言的转写。

# 1. 十几行代码，搭一个实时语音 Agent

核心是通过 WebSocket 连接实时接口，下面是官方文档的 Python 示例：
import asyncio
import json
import os
import websockets
async def voice_agent():
    async with websockets.connect(
        "wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime?model=grok-voice-latest",
        additional_headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['XAI_API_KEY']}"}
    ) as ws:
        # 配置声音并开启工具
        await ws.send(json.dumps({
            "type": "session.update",
            "session": {
                "voice": "eve",
                "instructions": "You are a helpful customer support agent.",
                "turn_detection": {"type": "server_vad"},
                "tools": [{"type": "web_search"}]
            }
        }))
        # 接收 AI 返回的音频
        async for message in ws:
            event = json.loads(message)
            if event["type"] == "response.output_audio.delta":
                # 播放音频：base64.b64decode(event["delta"])
                pass
asyncio.run(voice_agent())
几个关键点：

- instructions 就是 AI 的"人设"，改成"你是一家奶茶店的点单员"，它就能按这个角色说话。
- turn_detection: server_vad 由服务端判断"你说完了没有"，所谓"能被打断"靠的就是这个。
- tools 可以接入工具，比如联网搜索。这是它能"办事"而不只是"聊天"的原因。
- 返回的音频是分块的 base64，你要解码后喂给播放器。把麦克风的音频送上去的具体事件格式，请看官方的 Speech to Speech 文档。

做网页或手机 App 时，别把 API Key 写在前端，文档推荐用 临时令牌（Ephemeral Tokens） 来连接。官方仓库 xai-cookbook 里还有现成的 Web、Twilio 电话、WebRTC 和 iOS 示例。

# 2. 文字转语音：一条 curl 搞定
curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "text": "Welcome to SpaceXSI. How can I help you today?",
    "voice_id": "eve",
    "language": "en"
  }' \
  --output welcome.mp3
TTS 还支持在文本里插入语音标签（笑声、耳语、停顿），输出格式从高保真 MP3 到电话用的 μ-law 都有。

# 3. 声音克隆：两步走
import os
import requests
# 第一步：上传参考音频（最长 120 秒），创建自定义声音
with open("reference.wav", "rb") as f:
    create = requests.post(
        "https://api.x.ai/v1/custom-voices",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['XAI_API_KEY']}"},
        files={"file": ("reference.wav", f, "audio/wav")},
        data={"name": "Friendly Narrator", "language": "en"},
    )
voice_id = create.json()["voice_id"]
# 第二步：用这个声音合成语音
speech = requests.post(
    "https://api.x.ai/v1/tts",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['XAI_API_KEY']}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    json={"text": "Hello! This is my custom voice.", "voice_id": voice_id, "language": "en"},
)
with open("custom.mp3", "wb") as f:
    f.write(speech.content)
拿到的 voice_id 可以用在 TTS，也可以用在流式 TTS 的 WebSocket 和实时对话接口里。

# 4. 语音转文字
response = requests.post(
    "https://api.x.ai/v1/stt",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['XAI_API_KEY']}"},
    files={"file": ("recording.mp3", open("recording.mp3", "rb"), "audio/mpeg")},
    data={"model": "grok-voice-transcribe-2.0"},
)
print(response.json()["text"])
默认模型是 grok-voice-transcribe-2.0，支持词级时间戳、多声道、说话人分离，批量和流式两种模式都有。

# 可以做点什么？

- 给自己的小店做一个 24 小时接电话的预约助手
- 把会议录音转成带说话人标注的纪要
- 做一个用亲人声音朗读的有声书工具（请务必取得本人同意）
- 在 Twilio 上接一个能打电话的 AI，跑通完整的"电话客服"流程

技术的好坏，从来不取决于技术本身。

同一个 AI，可以让你少等 20 分钟客服，也可能让骗子的电话更像你的家人。我们能做的，是先搞懂它能干什么，再决定怎么用它、怎么防它。

下次电话那头的声音温柔又耐心，别急着感动，先问一句："你是真人吗？"

# NVIDIA Kumo: Open-Weight Models for Reasoning Over Structured Enterprise Data

On October 21, 2026, at GTC Berlin, NVIDIA announced the Kumo family of foundation models, designed specifically to connect AI agents to structured enterprise data. Part of the broader Agent Knowledge Foundation, Kumo addresses the 'Data Plumbing' challenge identified in the TGVP infrastructure report, where the inability to reason over databases remains a primary barrier to autonomous agent deployment.

The Kumo family includes specialized models for Tabular, Relational, Time Series, and Forecast data. While the company's Nemotron series handles unstructured documents, Kumo provides the prediction layer over structured records. In the announced workflow, the Nemotron tools parse documents, embed queries and rerank information, while the new Kumo models make predictions from structured data – classification and regression, in the model card's terms. As CEO Jensen Huang framed it at the keynote: "Ultimately, what turns these super agents, these agents into super agents, is that you give them access to your company's knowledge."

Availability is immediate: Kumo models are available as open weights on Hugging Face and packaged as NVIDIA NIM microservices on build.nvidia.com for production inference. The integration into the open-source NVIDIA Agent Toolkit allows developers to combine Kumo with Nemotron Retriever and OpenShell enforcement, creating a full-stack governance and knowledge foundation. NVIDIA claims the Kumo Tabular model provides up to a 20% improvement in prediction accuracy over standard gradient-boosted decision trees for agentic workloads (company-reported).

Advertisement

Advertisement

For enterprise architects, Kumo represents the verticalization of the data layer. By building a dedicated moat around how agents access structured data, NVIDIA is positioning itself as the essential infrastructure provider for both the safety (OpenShell) and the knowledge (Kumo) of the agentic economy. This release suggests that the future of agentic RAG is moving beyond simple document retrieval and toward a unified framework that treats structured databases as first-class citizens in the agent's context.

### OpenAI to make its most advanced AI models available in Google Cloud

OpenAI Group PBC today announced plans to make its latest large language models accessible in Google Cloud.

The LLMs will be available through the Alphabet Inc.’s unit Model Garden service. It provides access to more than 200 neural networks from Google, its partners and the open-source ecosystem. The lineup includes not only LLMs but also smaller, more specialized models optimized for tasks such as translation.

The first LLM OpenAI is bringing to Google Cloud is its flagship GPT-6 Astra model. The algorithm is responsible for several of the AI-produced math discoveries that the company has published in recent weeks. It also achieved a perfect score on ExploitBench, a benchmark that measures LLMs’ ability to find and exploit cybersecurity flaws.

Astra includes safety optimizations designed to make it suitable for enterprise use. According to OpenAI, the model causes “fewer misaligned outcomes” than all the other frontier models it has evaluated. It’s configured not to bypass user-defined restrictions on the tasks that it can perform.

Google Cloud customers will also receive access to GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, two scaled-down versions of Astra that OpenAI launched in late September. They trade off some output quality for a significant reduction in token pricing. Sol and Luna cost five and 100 times less than Astra, respectively.

“We are focused on giving customers a broad selection of models, including those from OpenAI, so they can choose the right model for any given job, helping to deliver optimal quality and lower costs,” said Google Cloud Chief Executive Thomas Kurian.

Cloud providers offer discounts to enterprises that sign long-term spending commitments. OpenAI says that Google Cloud customers can use those commitments to pay for access to its models. That removes the need for users to set up a new AI budget, which eases procurement.

Astra, Sol and Luna will become generally available in Google’s Model Garden within a few weeks. The companies plan to follow up the launch by bringing the models to the search giant’s Confidential Compute portfolio of infrastructure services.

Server-grade central processing units such as those Google uses include a security feature called TEE. The technology can encrypt a segment of the host server’s memory in a manner that only makes it accessible to a specific workload. Google’s Confidential Compute services use the technology to secure customer workloads. Additionally, they can ease use cases such as sharing a dataset among multiple organizations for AI training purposes.

OpenAI also plans to make its models available via Google’s Antigravity and Gemini Agent products. Antigravity is a vibe coding tool that uses agent ensembles to speed up software projects. Gemini Agent, in turn, is designed to automate business tasks that span multiple cloud applications.

# 既能“做选择题”，也能“做填空题”——星辰意图理解模型Xing4.0-29B-Intent发布

量子位的朋友们 2026-10-22 15:11:14 来源：量子位

中电信人工智能科技有限公司星辰通用人工智能实验室正式发布并开源意图理解专用模型 Xing4.0-29B-Intent

中国电信人工智能科技有限公司星辰通用人工智能实验室正式发布并开源意图理解专用模型 Xing4.0-29B-Intent，同步开放275万条训练语料、模型权重与推理镜像。模型将意图识别与参数抽取结合起来，把用户的一句话转换为业务系统可以继续处理的结构化信息。

目前，Xing4.0-29B-Intent模型能力已在电信万号客服、智能家居音箱等终端产品中开始应用，服务于对话意图识别、工单智能路由和口语指令解析。此次开源将为更多开发者提供模型及配套资源，支持接入各自的业务场景。

### 01判断题还是填空题

“帮我把卧室的灯调成暖黄。”一句日常的设备操作指令，既包含用户想做的事，也包含完成操作所需的具体信息。系统需要从自然表达中提取这些信息，才能交给后续应用处理。

面对这句话，仅判断出“控制灯光”还不够。系统还需要知道：哪个房间？卧室；什么设备？灯；调成什么状态？暖黄。

Jev类决策模型主要“做选择题”，返回类型化决策，从给定的候选中挑选答案；参数抽取相当于“做填空题”，提取完成任务所需的具体信息。Xing4.0-29B-Intent同时支持这两类任务，也支持一句话包含多个意图、多个参数和多个实体的情况。

模型采用统一模式驱动语义解析框架（USP，Unified Schema-driven Semantic Parsing），以“类别＋参数”的层级结构组织结果，按照预先定义的字段规则输出JSON格式信息。异构任务目标如：意图理解、实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取等任务统一采用统一套输入输出格式约束，便于下游任务快速接入，稳定解析，迁移成本极低。

### 02为什么不直接用通用大模型？

看到这里你可能会问：通用大模型不是已经“无所不能”了吗，为什么还要专门的意图理解模型？

因为在这类场景里，通用大模型有三个“先天短板”。

#### 第一，输出速度

通用大模型习惯“想清楚再回答”，动辄数百上千字的长篇推理，对于“工单转给谁”这样的问题，等它说完，客户早就挂电话了。Xing4.0-29B-Intent只对任务处理所需的关键决策信息做出快速响应，没有长篇推理，平均输出几十个token，完整结果响应时延可以做到百毫秒级。

#### 第二，决策成本

动用通用大模型去做分类和信息提取，无异于杀鸡用牛刀。意图理解模型规模小、调用省，当一个场景每天要调用上百万次时，成本差距会成倍放大。

#### 第三，决策可靠性

通用大模型的输出是自由文本，同一个问题可能得到十种说法，下游系统难以稳定解析。意图理解模型的输出被严格约束在预定义的结构里：字段确定、格式可校验，不给“自由发挥”留空间。

一句话总结：在响应及时度要求高、场景相对收敛、决策执行相对明确的地方，意图理解模型是比通用大模型更快、更便宜、更可靠的选择。

这条赛道已经有先行者。以Jev为代表的轻量级决策模型推出后，迅速成为开发者社区热议的焦点。市场的反响印证了一个判断：意图理解不必依赖大模型“强推理”，专用小模型同样可以做到又快又准。

### 03效果说话 两组评测检验识别与抽取能力

模型能否读懂用户多意图细粒度的需求，可以从两个层面检验：一是既判断对类别，又提取对具体内容；二是只看类别判断，能否做到不漏选、不多选。技术团队据此开展了两组评测，分别考察完整抽取结果和类别判断能力。

#### 第一组 不仅类别要对 具体内容也要对

第一组评测从48个中英文公开数据集中按比例抽取6000道题，覆盖意图理解、实体识别、关系抽取和事件抽取四类任务。它考察的不只是“分到哪一类”，还包括“具体提取出了什么”。

以前文的灯光指令为例，仅判断出“控制灯光”还不够，还要提取出“卧室”“灯”“暖黄”等信息。这个例子用于说明评分要求：类别正确但内容缺失或错误，不能算作完整正确的抽取结果。

总分先在四类任务中分别计算，再等权平均，因此代表四类任务的综合表现，并非将6000道题直接合并计算的答对比例。下表各项指标均为分数越高，表现越好。

Xing4.0-29B-Intent总分为58，高于本次参评的18款市面主流通用模型的最高总分49；四类任务的分项得分也均高于本次参评通用模型。

#### 第二组 只看类别判断 能否不漏选也不多选

第二组评测不评价参数或具体内容抽取，只比较模型能否找全、选准应输出的类别。评测共5606道题，包括3940道单一正确类别题和1666道多个正确类别题；这批题目中还包含839道“无可抽取内容”的负例题，用于检验模型在没有目标内容时是否会误报类别。

Jev采用两种答法参与测试：“N选1”是从候选类别中选出一个答案；“逐个判是非”是依次判断每个候选类别是否符合。下表同时保留GPT-6-Luna作为通用模型参照；两种答法仅指Jev，并不适用于表中所有模型。

这张表里真正要看的是两层：决策总分先把单选、多选、负例三个子项压成一个总决策分，看的是模型“找准、找全、不误报”的综合水平；三个子项再各看一件事——单选能否盯准唯一目标，多选能否一个不漏地点齐应选类别，负例能否在无目标内容时克制住、不误报。总分看整体，子项看短板，两者对上了才说明模型能力是扎实的。

### 04关于应用：这款模型适合谁？

在具体应用方面，电信万号客服系统中，Xing4.0-29B-Intent承担对话意图识别与工单智能路由，为不同客户诉求的分类、流转提供支持。在智能家居音箱等终端产品上，Xing4.0-29B-Intent将用户口语指令转换为设备可进一步处理的结构化指令，衔接自然语言交互与设备操作。

如果你在做：

终端交互

手机语音助手 / 智能座舱 / IoT中控

既要判意图，又要抽参数，还嫌大模型又慢又贵；

ToB客服 / 企业IM机器人

业务冷启动阶段没有足够的标注数据，不想为每个新意图标注海量样本；

Agent / Function Calling应用

需要一个稳定、低幻觉的“语义入口层”。

那么，你非常适合把Xing4.0-29B-Intent放进你的技术栈。

对于需要调用工具的智能体应用，模型可提供意图识别和函数调用参数抽取能力，为后续执行提供输入。

### 05开放Schema + 275万语料，欢迎试用

Xing4.0-29B-Intent基于星辰通用基座模型 Xing4.0-29B-A4B 微调，使用专用语料训练结构化输出能力。此次开源包含以下四类资源：

01 275.3万条监督微调训练语料

重构自61个公开数据集，覆盖19个领域、52种语言。

02 终端意图理解语料

星辰通用人工智能实验室面向手机端智能交互场景，构建中文口语理解基准CMPA-SLU，相关成果被EMNLP 2026录用《CMPA-SLU: A Benchmark for Chinese Mobile Personal Assistant Spoken Language Understanding》。

03 Xing4.0-29B-Intent模型权重

支持意图识别、参数抽取及统一格式的结构化输出。

04 官方推理镜像

\#\# OpenAI 宣布進駐 Google Cloud：最新 GPT\-5\.1 模型與 Codex 啟動私人預覽

作者 TechNews 編輯台 \| 發布日期 2026 年 10 月 22 日 10\:20 \| 分類 AI 人工智慧 \, ChatGPT \, Gemini 
查看翻译

Now Translating\.\.\.

OpenAI 與 Google 於 21 日正式宣布達成合作，將 OpenAI 的最新 AI 模型引進 Google Cloud，並深度整合至 Google 的 Antigravity 開發環境與 Gemini Agent 中。未來，企業客戶可直接在 Google Cloud 的 Model Garden 挑選並部署 OpenAI 模型，且相關交易皆可透過 Google Cloud Marketplace 一站式完成。

首波上線的 OpenAI 模型將先以「私人預覽」（Private Preview）的形式，提供給部分企業客戶測試，並計畫於日後逐步擴大開放範圍。Google Cloud 指出，引進的 OpenAI 模型將結合其平台既有的身分控管、資料治理及高效能基礎設施，這將賦予企業更高的運作彈性，能根據不同工作負載對效能、延遲與成本效率的要求，在各類模型間靈活切換。

此次進駐 Google Cloud 的模型陣容涵蓋了最新世代的 GPT\-5\.1 系列與 Codex 程式代理工具：

\- GPT\-5\.1：專為高強度任務設計，主打進階程式編碼、電腦操作、專業運算與科學研究。
\- GPT\-5\.1 mini：在效能逼近主力模型的同時，具備更優異的成本效益。
\- GPT\-5\.1 nano：鎖定日常大規模工作，主打極致的生成速度與經濟實惠的價格。
\- Codex 程式代理工具：支援更完整的軟體開發流程，不僅能自動生成程式碼片段，更能協助工程師處理繁複冗長的工程任務。

透過此次強強聯手，Google Cloud 強調其已成為目前業界唯一能同時提供「三大主流封閉式大型語言模型」的超大型雲端供應商，其平台上更匯集了超過 200 款第一方、第三方與開源模型供用戶彈性運用。

此外，對於已簽訂 Google Cloud 支出承諾（Commitment）的企業而言，未來可以直接沿用現有的合約與預算來採購 OpenAI 模型，大幅降低了新技術的導入門檻。OpenAI 方面則表示，儘管微軟（Microsoft）依然是其最主要的雲端合作夥伴，但此次擴大布局，充分展現了 OpenAI 將頂尖 AI 模型推廣至更廣泛企業與開發者應用場景的目標。

（首圖來源：Google Cloud）

# MiniMax 指定 Inferact 為 M3.1 Flash 的 API 發布合作夥伴。模型並未改變——改變的是服務層。

作者
Rowan Sterling
發佈日期

最新模型 · 20查看全部模型 →

基準測試：Artificial Analysis · 每日更新

返回全部文章

On 21 October 2026, two days after MiniMax-M3.1-Flash went generally available, MiniMax's account on X named Inferact an API launch partner for the model, crediting its vLLM expertise and describing the collaboration as building "the serving infrastructure for complex agent workloads." That is the entire public announcement: one post, no blog entry, no technical detail. It is worth taking seriously anyway, because it is the first thing anyone has said publicly about how this model is actually going to be served — and for a model whose headline claim is a threefold speed-up, the serving layer is not a footnote. It is the claim. The documented AI failures and agent incidents behind releases like this one are collected in the OrcaRouter AI Incident Archive where each entry carries its own sources, severity, confidence grade and disputed flag.

## 發布貼文未包含的內容

MiniMax published a proper launch post for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on 19 October 2026: agentic benchmarks, a 70% cost reduction, inference "nearly three times faster." It is a substantial piece of work, and it does not contain the word Inferact. It does not contain the word vLLM either. Whatever the partnership amounts to, the company did not consider it part of the launch story on the day the launch story was told.

That gap is the most informative thing in the announcement. A launch partner named two days late, in a social post, with no accompanying technical write-up, is a partner whose work is still in progress. If MiniMax had M3.1-Flash running on a tuned third-party stack at general availability, the launch post would have said so — day-zero serving on a named engine is exactly the kind of proof point a vendor puts in the body copy. Instead the claim arrives separately, without numbers, which tells you the collaboration is being announced at the point where it becomes a commitment rather than at the point where it becomes a result.

There is a second, smaller gap. Inferact's own site, checked on 22 October, carries a MiniMax logo among its partners and a testimonial attributed to Dr. Yan Junjie, MiniMax's founder and CEO. It also does not mention MiniMax-M3.1-Flash anywhere. Its case studies are about other models entirely. So the two companies have announced a partnership that neither company's marketing site yet describes in product terms. Read that as evidence of recency rather than of doubt: the X post is two days old, and partner pages are slow.

## Inferact 是什麼，以及為什麼 vLLM 的細節很重要

Inferact 自稱是「由 vLLM 創作者與維護者所創立的公司」。其團隊主導 vLLM 的發展藍圖，而引擎本身仍維持開源、Apache 2.0，並由 PyTorch Foundation 下的社群治理。這樣的結構正是這項合作比大多數發布合作夥伴公告更清晰易懂的原因：vLLM 並非黑箱，因此 Inferact 為 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 所做的任何改進，都有相當機會出現在所有人都在使用的開源引擎中。

The company sells two shapes of the same thing. Inferact Platform installs in a customer's own cloud or data centre — the site's phrasing is "Run inference on your compute" — with a control plane covering monitoring, rollout validation, cost tracking, autoscaling, endpoint management, metering and observability. Inferact Cloud is the same platform on GPUs Inferact provisions: "Run inference on our compute." The distinction matters for anyone reading the MiniMax announcement as an availability statement. An API launch partner on that model can mean managed endpoints someone else operates, or it can mean a software stack you install next to your own weights. For a closed model, only the first is possible, which narrows what this partnership can be.

## 為什麼這個特定模型先是服務問題，然後才是定價問題

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 對一款低價模型來說，形狀並不尋常，而正是這種形狀讓服務化問題成為關鍵所在。

• Thinking is always on — MiniMax's API reference returns HTTP 400 for thinking: {"type": "disabled"} and rejects reasoning_effort: "none" the same way, so the only control is a five-rung ladder from low to max, and omitting the field means max

• 因此，它的瓶頸在於解碼（decode-bound）——Artificial Analysis 在其 Intelligence Index 的執行過程中記錄到共消耗 1.8 億個輸出 token，而同一追蹤器上各模型的中位數為 9,900 萬個。

• 上下文視窗為 1,000,000 個 token，這使得 KV 快取記憶體成為限制單一節點能容納多少個並行代理工作階段的關鍵瓶緊。

• Agent 迴圈會重複使用一大段前綴——相同的系統提示、工具結構定義與檔案上下文會在每個步驟中反覆出現——因此前綴快取可直接轉化為延遲與金錢的節省

• 輸出速度測得為每秒 125.5 個 token，首個 token 時間為 1.04 秒；這在同級中算快，但一旦有多個長時間生成並行排隊，這正是最先被侵蝕的數字。

Put those together and you get a workload profile that rewards exactly the things vLLM is built for: paged attention so a million-token context does not have to be contiguous, prefix caching so agent steps do not re-prefill the same tool definitions, and continuous batching so a hundred half-finished reasoning traces share the hardware instead of queuing behind each other. MiniMax's own claim of 200+ tokens per second at peak and 170+ at median is a scheduling claim as much as a kernel claim. The 3× speed-up in the launch post is not something a better matrix multiply produces on its own.

## 存在嘅數字，同埋唔存在嘅數字

Inferact 公布效能數據，而這些數據各自依附於什麼對象，值得仔細閱讀。其網站宣稱：Kimi-K3 上市首日、批次大小為 1 時可達每秒 464 個 token；在 TPU 上以首個 megakernel 達到每位使用者每秒 709 個 token；同一模型在 SemiAnalysis AgentX 上每美元可處理 1,830 萬個 token；以及於 2026 年 5 月在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第一。上述每一項都是 Inferact 自行發布、針對不同模型之 Inferact 工程成果的主張；本文並未將其中任何一項轉述為關於 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 的事實。

What does not exist, as of 22 October, is any figure at all for M3.1-Flash on Inferact's stack: no tokens per second, no time to first token, no cost per million, no concurrency curve. The announcement is a commitment without a measurement. That is normal two days in, and it is also the only reason to be interested — the value of the partnership to a buyer will be entirely determined by whether those numbers turn out to beat what MiniMax serves on its own, and right now nobody outside the two companies knows what MiniMax serves on its own.

這才是證據目前的真實狀況。這個模型唯一獨立測得的吞吐量來自 Artificial Analysis，為每秒 125.5 個 token，而那是單一測試框架下的單流數據，並非服務基準測試。它只告訴你模型能快速生成，卻完全無法說明每美元能支撐多少同時使用者。
# MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost
2026-10-19

AI M3.1 Flash

Today, we officially roll out **MiniMax M3.1 Flash**.

Space Bunny (), which processed more than 200 trillion tokens while operating anonymously, was an early version of MiniMax M3.1 Flash.

As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding. Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.

## Stronger Capabilities Across the Board

M3.1 Flash improves across a broad range of benchmarks, reaching the level of leading models in complex agentic tasks (cowork), computer use, software development (coding), and cybersecurity.

## 合作夥伴公告究竟有多少價值

單憑自身不算多，卻也不只是空無。有三件事讓它不只是空無。

第一點是，它是第二個實作方。一個只由一家公司提供服務的模型，就是只有一種維運觀點的模型；而當那個觀點碰上糟糕的一週，你的產品也會碰上糟糕的一週。具名的合作夥伴意味著第二個團隊已經讀過架構、找到真正關鍵的 kernel，並且公開承諾到若無法交付會令人難堪的程度。那是個微弱訊號，但卻是真實的訊號，而這也正是讓第二個雲端區域值得付費的同一套邏輯。

The second is the agent-workload framing. MiniMax did not describe the partnership as "faster inference." It described it as serving infrastructure for "complex agent workloads," which is a specific and harder problem than chat throughput: long-lived sessions, tool calls interleaved with generation, prefixes that must survive across steps, and cost that scales with trajectory length rather than with prompt count. A partner chosen for that problem is a partner chosen for the workload MiniMax is marketing the model against. Whether the choice was correct is not yet testable.

第三點是，它為實際營運情況提供了時間定位。MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 正式全面推出已三天。權重尚未釋出——公司表示「將於之後釋出」，但沒有給出日期——因此沒有自行託管的退路，獨立第三方也無法在自己的硬體上對該模型進行基準測試。目前，關於這個模型在生產環境中表現的一切，都由提供服務的一方居中決定。首發合作夥伴是未來必須形成的一份清單中的第一項。

## 如果你正在選擇要在哪裡執行它，這對你意味著什麼

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is not on the OrcaRouter catalogue. It is callable today through MiniMax's own API, its M Plan and MiniMax Code, and — per the 21 October announcement — through Inferact. That is the full list we can vouch for, and none of it is a router: each of those is one place to get the model, with its own rate limits, its own availability and no second option behind it if it goes down.

這種單一供應商問題正是路由器的用途，也正是為什麼這裡有意思的問題不是「哪個合作夥伴」，而是「要幾個」。OrcaRouter 將 200+ 個模型置於同一個 API key 之後，以 0% 加價傳遞供應商標價，並可在路由表中保留一個備援，這樣對只有一個端點的模型的請求，就不會因為該端點短暫出狀況而變成服務中斷。路由 DSL 正是表達這件事的地方：某個需要 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 的代理步驟可以先指名它，再降級到你已經信任的模型，而呼叫端程式碼完全不知道發生了替換。

cross_cutting.description: 10月21日，百度在杭州办了一场“搭子”产品的发布会。所谓“搭子”，是百度去年推出的一款AI智能体应用——可以理解为一个能听懂任务、自己动手干活的“AI同事” ... 11月12日的百度世界2026大会上，“搭子”在企业场景的最新进展将与百度的全栈AI布局一并亮相。
cross_cutting.content:
百度“搭子”升级：“AI同事”进驻生产线

杭州网

2026\-10\-22 14\:32浙江杭州网络传媒有限公司官方账号

关注

10月21日，百度在杭州办了一场“搭子”产品的发布会。所谓“搭子”，是百度去年推出的一款AI智能体应用——可以理解为一个能听懂任务、自己动手干活的“AI同事”。这一次升级，百度想让它走出办公室，进企业的生产经营环节里试试身手。

据百度官方数据，“搭子”目前的企业客户数环比增长83\%，企业提出的“交付物”需求（也就是让AI直接产出报告、表格、代码等成果的需求）环比增长约4\.3倍。这大概是百度加快布局企业场景的直接原因。

它会干哪些新活？

简单来说有三类。

一是“动手操作”。升级后的“搭子”能识别电脑和手机界面，操作那些没有接口（API）的老系统，跨应用串联完成任务；对程序员群体，它还支持理解整个项目、修改代码、运行命令、接着调试，相当于一个能搭手的初级工程师。

二是“干专业活”。百度此前已经上线了30多个面向具体岗位的“专家套件”，这次新加了投标套件：读懂招标文件、检查投标文件、列出风险点。还有面向数据分析、Office文档处理的专业工作台。

三是“按企业的规矩干活”。很多企业不敢用AI，怕它不懂自家规范、瞎输出。这次“搭子”把企业知识库、任务看板和“记忆”功能串了起来——知识库存规章制度，看板管任务进度，记忆系统记住之前确认过的要求，下次接着用。此外，百度还配了一支叫FDE（Forward Deployed Engineer，前置部署工程师）的专家团队，帮企业梳理哪些场景适合用AI、怎么落地。

安全问题怎么解决？

这也是发布会花了不少篇幅的部分。新发布的“Agent安全中心”号称“6重防护、7道防线”：高危操作要人工授权、任务在隔离环境里运行、全程留痕可追溯。部署方式上，企业可选公有云、专有云、私有化或混合云。百度还与联想开天、麒麟、统信合作推出了国产软硬件环境下的通用智能体，并上线了第三方应用市场。

有企业真在用吗？

发布会上举了三个例子：

调味品品牌松鲜鲜用“搭子”追踪供应链降本。业务人员更新数据后，“搭子”每周自动分析采购、研发、仓储的进度，生成报告并推送给管理层。据企业方面反馈，单次汇总分析的时间从原来的2个工作日缩短到3分钟以内（不含数据采集环节），降本进度从月底汇总变成每周可查。

定制家具企业艾瑞卡把“搭子”和百度的“秒哒”工具结合，搭了销售管理后台：销售把与客户的沟通记录转发给企业微信机器人，“搭子”自动提炼客户诉求和跟进计划。

跨境电商服务商创想无垠则通过接口把业务数据接入“搭子”，员工用自然语言发起销售分析、库存检查等任务，关键环节保留人工审核。

# Beyond Now launches Wave AI Framework for telecoms
Thu, 22nd Oct 2026 (Today) 
KAREN JOY BACUDO Finance Editor

Beyond Now has launched its Wave AI Framework for communications service providers and technology companies. It is designed to support collaboration between AI agents across revenue-related processes.

The product allows Beyond Now's own agents to work alongside customer-built and third-party agents across sales, fulfilment, billing and partner operations. The system is open and model-agnostic, allowing customers to use different AI models and agents while setting controls over access, permissions and actions.

The launch extends the company's recently introduced Agentic Revenue & Ecosystem Orchestration Platform. Wave AI is positioned as the layer that gives agents business context, including information on customers, products, pricing and commercial rules, and enables them to operate across live systems with human oversight.

The company is addressing a practical problem that has emerged as AI agent development becomes easier. Building an agent is no longer the main obstacle. Businesses still need those agents to understand complex commercial environments, execute workflows across several systems and stay within defined operating limits.

For communications service providers, the issue is particularly acute because revenue processes often stretch across business support systems, sales tools, product catalogues and partner channels. In that environment, any agent that takes action needs access to current business data, as well as clear rules on what it can see and do.

Beyond Now has organised the framework into four layers. The Wave AI Interface provides a conversational way for users to interact with the Beyond Now platform. The Wave AI Workforce consists of role-based agents embedded across the platform, while the Wave AI Cockpit serves as a control plane for orchestration, governance and observability. A separate data layer supplies the business context agents need to make decisions and carry out tasks.

The framework also includes reusable AI skills, model context protocol components and application programming interfaces. These are intended to help agents connect with enterprise systems and with one another without creating a separate, disconnected AI layer inside the business.

Beyond Now has already linked Wave AI with Microsoft AI Foundry. Hrvatski Telekom is also introducing AI across business support systems, commerce and sales as part of a broader AI-first strategy.

Governance focus

Governance is a central feature of the framework. Companies need to define where human oversight remains necessary, what actions agents are allowed to take and which systems they can access before AI can be used safely across commercial processes.

That reflects a broader market shift towards what some companies describe as agent-to-agent interaction, where software agents work not only with people and internal systems but also with external agents across organisational boundaries. For telecoms operators and technology providers, this raises questions about security, accountability and control over commercial processes.

Beyond Now argues that these controls will matter as AI agents move into revenue-generating and customer-facing operations. That goes beyond answering queries or generating content into areas where agents may trigger fulfilment steps, support product sales or interact with billing functions.

"We're reaching the point where building another AI agent is relatively straightforward. Making that agent useful inside the business and turning that into growth is much harder. The next step is giving agents the ability to act across real commercial processes and work with other agents safely and securely. Wave AI Framework gives customers a governed way to do that, while keeping them free to use our agents, their own or others from across the wider AI ecosystem," said Angus Ward, Chief Executive Officer of Beyond Now.

The next phase of adoption is likely to involve agents operating across organisational boundaries, including external agents interacting directly with service provider systems and agents working with other agents. Wave AI is intended to support those interactions while retaining control over access, permissions and commercial processes.

# Templafy Launches Templafy Team, Enabling Professionals to Build and Share Their Own Document Agents

## New offering turns company knowledge, templates and best practices into customizable AI agents for creating professional, business-ready presentations

| Quelle: Templafy Limited Templafy Limited

NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Templafy, the agentic document generation platform, today announces the launch of Templafy Team, a new offering that enables professional teams to build, customize and share their own purpose-built Document Agents, powered by company knowledge, templates and trusted content.

As AI becomes increasingly embedded in everyday business workflows, professionals have more tools than ever to generate content, but ensuring the output is high-quality and consistent remains a challenge, particularly when teams are repeatedly creating similar presentations, proposals and client deliverables.

Designed for document-intensive teams, including consulting, professional services, financial services and sales, Templafy Team combines customizable Document Agents with Templafy's patented document generation technology. Rather than individuals repeatedly prompting AI or rebuilding presentations from previous work, business teams can now put their existing knowledge, expertise and best practices into shared agents that can be reused across recurring workflows.

Oskar Konstantyner, CPO at Templafy, comments: “AI has made it easier than ever to generate content, but generating a document is only one part of getting work done. The bigger opportunity is enabling teams to create AI agents that understand how their business operates, drawing on their own knowledge, expertise and established ways of working.

“With Templafy Team, we're combining the flexibility to build your own agents with the document generation capabilities needed to produce high-quality, business-ready work. Instead of everyone working with AI differently, teams can build on shared knowledge and best practices, creating a more consistent and scalable approach.”

The offering enables professional teams to:

- Build and share custom Document Agents: Create and customize AI agents for recurring business needs, turning individual expertise and ways of working into reusable capabilities for the whole team.
- Put company knowledge to work: Ground AI in trusted company information, methodologies and best practices, so outputs reflect the business rather than relying on prompts alone.
- Create professional, on-brand PowerPoints: Generate native, editable presentations using company templates and approved assets, reducing the time spent rebuilding and formatting AI-generated outputs.
- Work within existing AI workflows: Access Templafy Document Agents through PowerPoint, ChatGPT, Claude and Microsoft Copilot, without requiring teams to change the tools they already use.
- Go beyond initial generation: Use AI agents to develop presentations, make edits and review outputs against company knowledge and standards.

Templafy Team is available with a 14-day free trial. For more information, visit https://www.templafy.com/teams/.

Notes to editors

About Templafy

Templafy is the leading agentic document generation platform, enabling professionals to create accurate, compliant, and on-brand documents with maximum efficiency.

Our platform allows enterprises to curb AI in the moments that matter by giving AI agents the right context, guardrails, and company-approved knowledge to work from. Through our approach, AI agents apply a combination of AI generated content and rules-based automation to create high-quality and trustworthy documents at speed, without compromising organizational control or consistency, at a low and predictable token cost.

Accessible directly within tools like Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Salesforce, and AI Assistants including Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot, Templafy’s patented technology simplifies document workflows, reduces risk, and gives teams greater confidence in the documents that matter most.

More than 4 million users worldwide rely on Templafy to accelerate business content creation with AI. Trusted by industry leaders including KPMG and BDO, Templafy saves teams over 30% of the time they would typically spend on repetitive content, such as proposals, engagement letters, and audit reports, allowing them to focus on revenue-driving work instead.
